doc: W2-BUILDSYS modular building. Pieces snap on one global module lattice (module_m metres, even 1 m grid cells). Slots: cell (a module square at a level), edge (a module side at a level), corner (a module corner at a level), door (inside a doorway edge). Level 0 is the foundation floor; level k >= 1 is the ceiling/floor k storeys up. piece_tiers holds one blueprint per piece x tier in the spec-10 section-11 shape (material_slots, minimum/maximum_level, required_skill_node, required_building_ability, supported_building_effects) plus model (res:// GLB path; empty = procedural stand-in) and max_durability. Saved pieces are building instances: id, blueprint_id, tier, owner_id, level, inherited_attributes, max_durability, current_durability, position, rotation, container_id. placed_kinds gives the kit-placed kinds (workbench, fence, ...) their durability and repair materials.
model_contract: 1 unit = 1 m, +Y up. cell pieces: origin at the module square's centre on its floor (2 x 2 m footprint); oriented pieces (roof, stairs, ramp) rise toward +Z at rot 0. edge pieces: origin at the edge midpoint on the floor, the wall plane runs along X (2 m wide), thickness on Z centred, height +Y (storey_m). corner pieces: origin on the corner, height +Y. door: origin at the doorway's edge midpoint, leaf hinged at -X of the opening. Rotation is applied by the game; the model needs no collision (the game builds it).
